entries.title: Quilla Emulator Gate
entries.summary: Host script boots CoreGuard_ATD35 (lean google_atd) and runs unit + am-instrument + smoke. On-device Quilla reports emulator presence and smokes Quantum Correlate — she cannot spawn QEMU from the APK.
entries.body: Deadline harness: HEADLESS=1 ./scripts/quilla-emulator-tests.sh. Prefers AVD CoreGuard_ATD35, builds with -Pcoreguard.emulatorAbi=x86_64, runs :app:testDebugUnitTest, installs debug+androidTest, then adb am instrument for QuillaQuantumOnDeviceTest and MainActivityLaunchTest (Gradle connectedDebugAndroidTest often ANRs on no-KVM TCG), then smoke-adb.sh. QuillaEmulatorGate.probe() detects ranchu/goldfish and runs an idle quantum circuit. Magick gate names still label classical math only.
entries.defense: Use the host harness before Play uploads. Treat emulator PASS as silicon proof, not occult assurance. Prefer KVM hosts — software graphics is slow. Application defers native/billing under instrumentation so silicon can finish startup.
